name: RenderLite
description: Adjustable CPU priority, power throttling and timer settings for Geometry Dash on Windows.

priority-level.name: Process priority (Windows)
priority-level.description: How much CPU time Windows gives the game. Strongest: High. Options: Normal (Windows default), Above normal (medium), High (strongest).

throttling-mode.name: Power throttling (Windows)
throttling-mode.description: Stops Windows from slowing the game down to save power. Strongest: CPU and timer throttling off. Options: Windows default (no change), CPU throttling off (medium), CPU and timer throttling off (strongest).

timer-resolution.name: Timer resolution (Windows)
timer-resolution.description: How precisely Windows times frames, which can make frame pacing more even. Strongest: 1 ms. Options: Windows default (about 15 ms), 2 ms (medium), 1 ms (strongest).
